title: 第1137章 喧嚣的吕家第1136章 黎明已至
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
第1137章喧嚣的吕家
沈清漪抿嘴一笑。
一双美眸笑盈盈的看着公子。
“公子可考虑好了？”
对于姜家依附于公子这件事。
沈清漪是支持的。
如今的吕家还很弱小。
离不开姜家的庇护。
如果两家的关系能够更进一步。
吕家未必不能坐稳沧澜城四大家族之一这把交椅。
李蒙点了点小脑袋。
“沧澜城是个不错的地方，对你们两家而言是个不错的起点，收下姜家对吕家更是百利而无一害，我没有拒绝的理由，就如他们所愿吧。”
沈清漪伸出纤纤玉手端起了茶壶。
为公子斟了一杯灵茶。
放下茶壶的沈清漪转头看向了楼亭外的朱怀英。
见沈清漪看向了自己。
有些失神的朱怀英回过神来。
朱怀英一脸复杂的看了一眼李蒙。
然后转身头也不回的离去了。
沈清漪若有所思的看着朱怀英离去的背影。

虽然有些好奇朱怀英为何会与公子在一起。
但不该问的沈清漪从不会多问。
公子留下朱怀英自有打算。
虽说沈清漪觉得公子把朱怀英留在身边很不理智。
毕竟公子灭了朱家满门。
如此血海深仇身为朱家主母的朱怀英心中怎会无恨。
沈清漪起身站了起来。
“公子，妾身去送送她吧。”
李蒙摆了摆小手。
“去吧。”
沈清漪纤纤玉脚后退一步。
双手放于腰间行了一个很端庄的礼。
然后转身走出了楼亭。
朝着朱怀英离去的方向追了上去。
就在沈清漪离去不久后。
李蒙端起茶杯正欲喝一口清漪斟的灵茶。
楼亭中不知何时又多了一人。
小黑不知何时来的。
她乖巧的坐在李蒙身旁的石凳上。
content_en:
Chapter 1137 The noisy Lu family
Shen Qingyi pursed her lips and smiled.
A pair of beautiful eyes looked at the young master with a smile.
"Master, have you thought about it?"
Regarding the fact that the Jiang family is attached to the young master.
Shen Qingyi supports it.
Today's Lu family is still very weak.
He cannot do without the protection of the Jiang family.
If the relationship between the two families can go further.
The Lu family may not be able to secure its position as one of the four major families in Canglan City.
Li Meng nodded.
"Canglan City is a good place and a good starting point for you two. Taking over the Jiang family will be of great benefit to the Lu family. I have no reason to refuse. Just do as they wish."
Shen Qingyi stretched out her slender hand and picked up the teapot.
I poured a cup of spiritual tea for the young master.
Shen Qingyi put down the teapot and turned to look at Zhu Huaiying outside the pavilion.
He saw Shen Qingyi looking at him.
Zhu Huaiying, who was a little distracted, came back to his senses.
Zhu Huaiying glanced at Li Meng with a complicated expression.
Then he turned around and left without looking back.
Shen Qingyi looked at Zhu Huaiying's leaving figure thoughtfully.
Although I am a little curious as to why Zhu Huaiying is with the young master.
But Shen Qingyi never asked more than he should.
The young master left Zhu Huaiying with his own plans.
Although Shen Qingyi felt that it was irrational for the young master to keep Zhu Huaiying by his side.
After all, the young master destroyed the entire Zhu family.
How could Zhu Huaiying, the mistress of the Zhu family, have no hatred in her heart due to such a blood feud.
Shen Qingyi stood up.
"Master, please go and see her off."
Li Meng waved his little hand.
"Go ahead."
Shen Qingyi took a step back with her slender feet.
He put his hands on his waist and made a very dignified salute.
Then he turned around and walked out of the pavilion.
He chased after Zhu Huaiying in the direction he left.
Not long after Shen Qingyi left.
Li Meng picked up the tea cup and was about to take a sip of the clear tea.
I don't know when there was another person in the pavilion.
Xiao Hei didn't know when he came.
She sat obediently on the stone bench next to Li Meng.
